entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say your reason for calling.
I need to... I guess, make a return.
Connecting you with the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to return a helmet I bought. I'm just so disappointed, I thought it would be perfect.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF88602. It's just... the color isn't what I expected from the pictures online. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this is the first time I've felt this let down. The box is still unopened and everything.

I understand. Getting the color right is important. Thank you for that order number, let me just pull it up here... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on January 3rd. Is that correct?
That's the one. I really needed that money for something else this month, and I just feel terrible about having to do this.

No need to feel terrible at all. I've just checked our policy. You are well within the 90-day return window, so I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you. We want to make sure your gear is perfect, especially when it comes to safety.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried it would be a problem.

Not a problem in the slightest. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you the prepaid return label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, that's incredibly kind. You've really turned my day around. Thank you for making it so easy.
It's my pleasure. You should see that email now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. I'll get that helmet sent back today. Thanks again, David!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
